correctness.rationale: The full bounded selector space has \(2^{10}\) elements and its four-balanced patterns are enumerated from all 4845 possible quadruples; exactly 692 contain an obstruction. A separate exhaustive \(7^5\) zero-sum search yields signed nonzero representations for precisely the complementary 332 masks and explicitly verifies all 64 coalition membership predicates. Every possible mask and bounded witness is tested, and all 720 label permutations give the orbit sizes. Positive normalization with integer weights \(q_i=7+w_i\) and complement argument prove correctness. The specific four listed coalitions have incidence (2,2,2,2,2,2).
